summary: Tiffany co-authored a November 2023 editorial calling the permanent defeat of Hamas a 'moral imperative' and opposing resettlement of Gazans in the US. He co-introduced the GAZA Act (WI-07) to block new US visas and parole for Palestinian Authority passport holders, and by March 2024 remained supportive of Israel despite calls for a ceasefire. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090, which directs use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement, and was rated Opposed by Vote for Peace.
